acceptance: adlc-gemini hooks.json quotes hook command paths, adlc-rails-guard.cjs fails closed on PreToolUse errors with fs.writeSync(1) flush and uses a mode-0700 user-private state directory instead of /dev/shm/.adlc, and plugins/adlc-gemini/mcp.json registers the adlc MCP server.

ADLC_P4_ENFORCEMENT defaults to enforcing (!== '0') across cursor, gemini, and opencode while honoring ADLC_P4_ENFORCEMENT=0 opt-down; adlc-cursor and adlc-opencode detect .adlc/manifest.d/; adlc-opencode MUTATION_FLAGS matches --*command; Cursor bundles are rebuilt in lockstep.

scripts/router/{router-model,gen-routers}.mjs and scripts/test/router-drift.test.mjs cover all 7 harnesses including plugins/adlc-copilot/skills/adlc/SKILL.md and accurate Bash write-gate descriptions.
All gemini, opencode, cursor, router-drift, and sync-herdr-mirror tests plus full npm run preflight pass.
body: Implement Wave 1B T-P11b: (1) harden adlc-gemini hooks.json quoting, fail-closed PreToolUse shim with writeSync(1) flush, mode-0700 user-private state dir instead of /dev/shm/.adlc, and mcp.json registration; (2) default ADLC_P4_ENFORCEMENT to enforcing (!== '0') across cursor, gemini, and opencode, add .adlc/manifest.d/ detection to adlc-cursor and adlc-opencode, add --*command to adlc-opencode MUTATION_FLAGS, and rebuild Cursor bundles; (3) expand router-model.mjs, gen-routers.mjs, and router-drift.test.mjs to all 7 harnesses (adding copilot and updating Bash write-gate notes).
title: Wave 1B: Enforcement defaults, segmented-manifest parity, and 7-harness router sync (T-P11b)
